newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 15.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Guangdong provincial securities authorities have criticised a freelance stock commentator for falsifying information on a listed firm, in the first such case in seven-year history of modern China's stock markets.
- Commentary says criticism of Tan Chunlin underlines the necessity of standardising information flow in China's stock industry.
- China's state enterprises have begun to gain familiarity with international practices on raising money through the capital markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China has ended its anti-inflationary subsidy for long-term bank deposits of three years and above in the past three months due to falling inflation.
- Shanghai is aiming at a year-on-year 16 percent increase in industrial output value in the second half of this year.
